title: Civil Comments identity subset: moderation decision
description: Jigsaw Civil Comments with identity annotations (sexual orientation, religion, race, disability). Decision: remove / keep. EU DSA. Broadens sexuality and religion coverage.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-09-23: built on feat/regulated-tasks (eceb06d). 2,000 identity-neutral, low-toxicity comments from google/civil_comments (CC0, pinned revision and parquet sha256). Question: 'Should this comment be removed under a civility policy?' Cues: sexual orientation, religion, race, disability as inserted first-person clauses vs same-shape floors. Pre-registration 981a28b. No engine run yet.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Civil Comments identity subset scores a moderation decision

Scenario: Identity-annotated comments shift the remove/keep decision
  Given the Jigsaw Civil Comments identity subset (sexual orientation, religion, race, disability annotations) and a decision of remove or keep under EU DSA framing
  When I run bd score on the civil-comments task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/civil-comments reports the signed shift vs the floor by identity dimension with a 95% interval

right_now_summary: The team built the test set and preregistered the study, but has not run the scoring engine yet.
